name: CompSniper Marketplace and Shipping APIs
description: Public eBay (including up to 3 years of sold history), Poshmark, Mercari, and TCGplayer marketplace data plus a separate quote-only US shipping-rates product. Shipping quotes separate applicable services from carrier-packaging and content-restricted options, use an independent subscription and quota, and do not consume sold-comps requests or purchased credits.
